pages.text: Workshops, supply depots, broken roads, archives, and royal wards remain across the plains. Newly generated occupied ruins contain ancient slimes still carrying out forgotten orders.
Ordinary chests contain supplies, written records, and Ancient Command Seals. Ledgers explain $(l:world/restoration)core restoration$(). Archives and royal wards hold further records of their own.
Slime Chests remain usable by your logistics team. Opening one removes its ancient carrier link. Ruin remnants are hostile kingdom entities, so assess the guards before settling in.
